changes.to: Commercial floor-cleaning robot (sweeping, scrubbing, dust mopping); the catalog excludes cleaning robots, and it is not a humanoid.

Scope flag: C5 is a commercial floor-cleaning robot, which the catalog excludes, so the record sits in Misc instead of Humanoid; it is not a humanoid. AGIBOT calls it its first intelligent cleaning robot for medium-to-large scenes. AGIBOT's 2026-10-29 product brochure (pp. 48-49, C-series table) and its own product and store pages state 820 x 680 x 1130 mm, 170 kg, 1.0 m/s, scrubbing 3 h on a 24 V 80 Ah battery with 1.5 h charging, 550 mm scrubbing width (840 mm with the side brushes), 730 mm squeegee, 90 L clean and 45 L dirty water, 1.8 L dustbin, up to 1,980 m2/h with a 95% debris pickup rate, 900 mm minimum aisle, 1,720 mm turning radius, 25 kg downforce and under 68 dB(A); the workstation holds 8 L, refills at 7-10 L/min, drains at 10-15 L/min and draws up to 1,800 W. The maker's store lists it at USD 32,900 (checked 2026-11-26, shown as out of stock) with no statement of what the price covers, so no price observation is recorded here.
AGIBOT's commercial floor-cleaning robot for medium-to-large indoor spaces, combining sweeping, scrubbing and dry mopping with a station that charges, refills and drains it.
